description: Derived from AGSC-05-21: two published items of one `type` whose `title` values are equal after NFC and case folding are the warning AGSC-E416. The minimal fixture holds the concept `handoff`, titled Handoff, and its lint reports nothing. Three items are added, each conforming in every key and a member of the fixture's cluster: the concept `the-handoff` titled HANDOFF, equal to Handoff after case folding, so one warning; the draft concept `draft-supervisor` titled Supervisor, equal to the published concept `supervisor`, which raises nothing because a draft is not published (AGSC-06-30); and the cluster `handoff-cluster` titled Handoff, which raises nothing because a cluster is not of the concept's type. The whole list is one AGSC-E416 warning, and lint exits 0. The rule names no item of the pair as the one that carries the finding, so `file` and `slug` are not asserted.
